notes: Final images copied unchanged from the built-in tool output. Consolas requested; generated lettering is an approximation, not typeset text. Source photos are retained unchanged.

stages.prompt:
Use case: compositing.
Asset type: finished product thumbnail for the VeryOS simple_cylindrical_screwing_containerV2 project.
Input 1 is the authoritative EDIT TARGET, a real photograph of the user's 3D-printed screw-top containers. Input 2 is a supporting EXACT VeryOS brand logo rendered from the repository's veryos_logo.svg. Input 3 is the supporting official yellow OpenSCAD logo.
Use the actual photographed products as the foreground hero. Preserve each container's cylindrical proportions, photographed surface patterns, visible layer lines and print imperfections, necks and threads, lids, seams, and green/purple shiny filament color. Keep the physical assembly and the arrangement of the objects from the photograph. Do not synthesize new product geometry or replace the products with idealized CAD renders. Remove the surrounding tabletop and room background and gently improve exposure against a warm ivory seamless studio background (#F4EFE3), with natural contact shadows. Do not put logos or text on the physical products.
Art direction: restrained premium maker-project cover, warm ivory, charcoal (#252C2B), a small muted amber accent (#BD711F), generous margins, clean visual hierarchy. The products' green and violet provide the color. No decorative patterns, collage frames, diagrams, callout arrows, people or added objects.
Typography: all text in Consolas, bold monospaced Consolas for the main title, regular Consolas for supporting copy. Text must be sharp, high contrast, large and readable at thumbnail size.
Exact text, no other copy:
Small eyebrow: "PARAMETRIC STORAGE"
Large headline on two lines: "SCREW-TOP" / "CONTAINER V2"
Supporting line: "Choose your texture."
Small feature line: "7 CUSTOMIZER PRESETS"
Footer at bottom-left: exact supplied VeryOS logo plus "VeryOS".
Footer at bottom-right: exact supplied OpenSCAD logo plus "OpenSCAD".
Reproduce the provided logos faithfully as small clean footer marks with no bounding boxes: preserve VeryOS's flat base, angled upper arms, circular upper contour, and two curved S cutouts. Keep both logos and wordmarks well within the canvas margin. A subtle thin footer divider is fine.
Do not add dimension claims, material claims, badges, watermarks or other lettering. Deliver one complete thumbnail, not a mockup.

FORMAT: LANDSCAPE, exactly 1536 x 1152 pixels, 4:3 aspect ratio.
Use the original photo's open containers and detached lids together as one coherent group: preserve the composition and number of photographed containers and lids, the front spiral-pattern body and leaning lid on the left, the front ribbed body and leaning lid on the right, and the other open containers behind. The purple lid leaning upright near the back-center stays recognizable. Remove only the background clutter.
Layout: the title block sits at upper left, large but leaving breathing room. The product group is large across the lower center/right, occupying about two thirds of the canvas width and much of the lower half. Keep all objects intact, well clear of text and the footer. Supporting text beneath the headline. The small "7 CUSTOMIZER PRESETS" line can sit in the open space at left below the supporting line. Ensure the full headline is legible and the products are prominent.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Input 1 is the edit target: finished landscape product thumbnail. Input 2 is the EXACT VeryOS logo on ivory, the authoritative replacement graphic.
Make ONLY two typography/branding corrections to input 1:
1. Replace the INCORRECT symbol next to "VeryOS" at bottom left with the EXACT mark in input 2. Copy its silhouette and cutouts precisely: it is one connected solid black V-shaped bowl with two outward diagonal upper arms, a round upper arch and flat horizontal bottom, containing a large S-shaped negative-space swirl. It has NO separate circular dot or separated leaf shapes. Preserve the original logo aspect ratio. Blend its ivory background into the footer. Keep it the same small footer footprint, beside the existing "VeryOS" wordmark.
2. Replace the heavy athletic/block headline font with actual Consolas Bold styling: clear fixed-width programmer monospace lettering, regular-width strokes, the capital I has horizontal bars at top and bottom, the letter R has Consolas's normal diagonal leg, and rounded letters have natural curves. It should match the monospaced character of the existing supporting line, just larger and bolder. Exact two-line headline remains "SCREW-TOP" / "CONTAINER V2". Fit it in the same upper-left area, reducing font size slightly if needed to leave clear space before the purple upright lid.
Keep all other lettering, all products and their photographed details, the colors, composition, background, OpenSCAD logo and footer unchanged. Do not redraw or rearrange the product group. Preserve the exact 4:3 aspect ratio and current resolution 1448 x 1086.
